next_steps.action: Measure the controller FB / VSEN / ISEN pins. For CPU VRM, also confirm the VID bits from the CPU are valid (consult CPU datasheet — VID set is platform-specific).

measure.what: FB / VSEN / ISEN pin voltages + VID bus state
measure.where: Controller FB, VSEN, ISEN pins; CPU VID pins
measure.instrument: DMM DC volts + oscilloscope for VID bus
measure.expected: FB at VREF per datasheet; VSEN should reflect the rail voltage; ISEN pins reflect per-phase current sense.
measure.safety: VID is set by the CPU and is board/CPU-specific. Never assume a VID value.

interpretations.if_result: FB at VREF and rail voltage present
FB correct but rail still missing
interpretations.then: Switching is happening but no energy reaches output. Open inductor, blown current-sense resistor, or shorted output FET pulling rail down. Inspect output stage.
CPU is not driving VID (CPU socket contact issue or dead CPU). Cannot diagnose VRM without valid VID.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need controller datasheet (FB/VSEN/ISEN pins, VREF) AND CPU datasheet (VID encoding) to interpret.
